title.zh: 复盘接触与继续的区别
title.en: Review an encounter separately from continuing

paragraphs.zh: 接着上面的最小接触，记录原本好奇什么、实际接触了哪一小段、现在是否还想继续。继续、暂缓和到此为止都可以说清，不必用新爱好或更大胆的行为证明开始成功。把条件不足与没有兴趣分别保留。
paragraphs.en: After the minimal encounter above, note your question, what you actually encountered and whether you want more. Continuing, deferring and stopping are all describable outcomes. No new hobby or bolder act is needed to prove success. Keep missing conditions separate from lack of interest.

paragraphs.en: After the small version above, separate available materials, what works and what is still missing. A sketch, one usable part or no feasible version can be described. A demonstration is not full completion. Ask for support if wanted; available resources do not grade your capability.

paragraphs.en: After the three-column note above, retain your response as experience, mark an inference as unconfirmed and choose a checkable question. You can keep uncertainty and decide within your limits. Ambiguity certifies no intuition, and declining need not wait for a complete explanation of every reason.

title.en: Review conditions and your willing contribution

paragraphs.en: After the small matter you want to sustain, check its need, your capacity and a pause condition. Attending to yourself, sharing work or not maintaining it now are choices. Effort proves neither love nor worth. One change is enough without taking responsibility for an entire space or everyone’s needs.

paragraphs.en: After the three-line agreement above, check explicit scope, voluntary ownership and a usable review point. Keep a useful part or revise an awkward step. Clarity need not mean permanence, and a request for an exception need not mean disregard for rules.

paragraphs.en: After the established-practice note above, separate its source, your actual experience and where it does not fit. Record an unclear source and say when a detail needs checking. Retaining experience can coexist with revision; age or status cannot replace relevant conditions.

title.en: Review valuing a connection and agreeing this time

paragraphs.en: After the shared arrangement above, retain volunteered needs and explicitly accepted options separately. Valuing a connection need not mean joining this time. If nothing fits everyone, reschedule or arrange separately. Investment and concessions need not become tests of affection.

paragraphs.en: After the small goal above, check the intended scope, actual step and when conditions need reviewing. Narrowing or pausing need not mean failure; continuing still needs capacity. Describe one concrete development rather than treating a count as proof of execution ability.

paragraphs.en: After the sentence about a need above, check its current answer, scope and any chosen response time. Gentle or more direct wording, or no message, are available. Immediate approval is not the grade; suppressing emotion or remaining in an uncomfortable exchange proves no strength.

paragraphs.en: After the change that already happened, separate new facts, remaining choices and needed support. Disappointment or stability are available without performing effortless adaptation. The outcome belongs to that event, not a luck score or recurring card cycle.

paragraphs.en: After the original and alternative question above, note new understanding, missing information and whether you want to continue. A pause need not produce revelation. Communicate a review point for shared matters. The name requires no sacrifice, literal inversion or discomfort.

title.en: Review which assumption needs a local correction

paragraphs.zh: 接着上面的原假设与新信息，指出实际不合的一处，再比较最小可撤回修正。也可以先核对记录或保留现状；一处尺寸不合不说明整个人或整件事失败。无须制造动荡、删除已有部分或给困难补上灾难预告。
paragraphs.en: After the assumption and new information above, name the mismatch and compare a minimal reversible correction. Check a record or retain the arrangement for now. One wrong dimension does not make a person or whole task a failure. No disruption, discarded work or disaster forecast is needed.

title.zh: 可选分享：从一个虚构小问题开始
title.en: Optional sharing: a small fictional question

paragraphs.zh: 虚构纸作与边框尺寸不合，你会先量哪里、核对哪条记录？可以只改局部，不要求推倒重来。
paragraphs.en: If an imaginary paper piece does not fit a frame, what would you measure or check? A local correction can suffice without starting over.

paragraphs.zh: 可以只分享这份公开通用读法，也可以不分享。链接不含本次答案或计数；对方可以不回答，不需要互评性格、披露私人经历或用真实事件验证牌名。

title.zh: 复盘可能性与已知限度
title.en: Review a possibility within known limits

paragraphs.zh: 接着上面的可能性记录，看看仍想保留什么、哪项限制确实存在、是否有可用支持。可以没有期待，也可以今天不行动。后来没有实现不说明希望错误或努力不够，留一个选项也不保证好运、疗愈或恢复。
paragraphs.en: After the possibility note above, check what you want to retain, a real limit and available support. No anticipation or action today is required. An unrealised option does not prove wrong hope or insufficient effort. Keeping one promises neither luck, healing nor recovery.

title.zh: 可选分享：从一个虚构小问题开始
title.en: Optional sharing: a small fictional question

paragraphs.zh: 虚构一个暂时没空的兴趣，你想留一份入门资料，还是暂不考虑？不必互相保证未来会更好。
paragraphs.en: For an imaginary interest with no time now, would you retain an introduction or leave it aside? No promise of a better future is required.

paragraphs.zh: 可以只分享这份公开通用读法，也可以不分享。链接不含本次答案或计数；对方可以不回答，不需要互评性格、披露私人经历或用真实事件验证牌名。

title.zh: 复盘观察、联想与可查内容
title.en: Review observations, associations and checkable points

paragraphs.zh: 接着上面的三栏，给实际看见的内容与自己补出的故事分别留位置，再选一处可核对的问题。不能查的可以保留未知，没回复也不证明某种解释。想象可以有趣，但不用把它写成别人必须承认的事实或预感。
paragraphs.en: After the three-column note above, keep observations separate from the story you added and choose one checkable point. Uncheckable parts can remain unknown. A missing reply does not confirm your explanation. Imagination may be interesting without becoming a fact or premonition others must accept.

paragraphs.zh: 虚构活动通知缺地点，你知道什么、想到什么、想问什么？不需要分享梦境或猜主办者的心思。
paragraphs.en: If an imaginary notice lacks a location, what is known, imagined and worth asking? No dreams or guesses about the organiser’s mind are needed.

title.zh: 复盘享受与是否愿意分享
title.en: Review enjoyment and whether to share it

paragraphs.zh: 接着上面的普通细节，分别记喜欢的是什么、当时感受和是否想告诉别人。也可以不记、不分享或很快继续做别的；没有愉快无需特意寻找。一次开心不认证健康或持续状态，也不用承担让别人开心的任务。
paragraphs.en: After the ordinary detail above, separate what appealed, your response and whether sharing is wanted. No record, no sharing or moving on are available; nothing enjoyable need be sought out. One pleasant moment certifies no health or lasting state and creates no task to cheer others up.

paragraphs.en: If an imaginary break brings a pattern you enjoy, would you look, note it or keep it private? Others need not share the feeling.

title.zh: 复盘当时可知与现在新增的信息
title.en: Review what was knowable then and what is new

paragraphs.zh: 接着上面的普通决定，把当时资料、现在变化和希望改的一处分别写清。若没有相关新信息，可以保留原安排，不必找错。修正不要求惩罚过去的自己，也不让别人因你的回看而必须改变。
paragraphs.en: After the ordinary decision above, separate information available then, present changes and one wanted revision. Keep the original arrangement if nothing relevant is new. Revision needs no punishment of your earlier self and places no demand on others to change with your review.

paragraphs.zh: 接着上面的完成记录，核对原用途、实际做过的部分和可以继续未知的地方。可以庆祝，也可以安静收好，不立刻新增任务。承认局部完成不需要让全部生活收口，更不证明圆满、成熟或未来成功。
paragraphs.en: After the completion note above, check its original purpose, actual work and unknowns that may remain. Celebrate or put it away quietly without another immediate task. Recognising local completion requires no closure across life and proves neither fulfilment, maturity nor future success.
